messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert - surge in agent-exec (external-action) invocations across hosted + dedicated clusters. api-prod-1 showing 2.1k/min (threshold 800/min). Paging on-call. Details: https://internal.redwood.ai/incidents/2800012345
Morgan: ACK - I'm oncall. Can we confirm customer-visible impact? @support_ana @sales_tom
support_ana: Seeing reports from 3 customers: intermittent timeouts and malformed structured responses when agent attempts external actions. No full outage, but error rate up ~18%.
Raj: Pulling runtime traces now. Early signal: possible feedback loop from a new third-party bot that repeatedly triggers action calls.
Morgan: Proposed mitigations: 1) soft-throttle agent-exec globally (per-tenant caps) 2) temporarily disable structured output generation (force plain text) 3) reduce free-tier agent quotas 4) notify customers + update status page. Any objections?
Lee: +1 to the plan. Prepare the ops commands and safe rollback steps.
Morgan: Executing throttle now.

```
# throttle agent-exec (soft cap by tenant)
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/mitigate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"mode":"throttle","target":"agent-exec","scope":"global","rate_per_tenant":10}'
```
incident-bot: job queued (98321). Estimated rollout ~5s.
Raj: Throttle applied across edge gateways. Confirming drop in aggregate QPS.
Morgan: Next, flip structured-output feature to off for hosted + dedicated. This will force plain-text responses for any agent-invoked flows.
```
# disable structured output feature flag for hosted/dedicated
/ops feature-flag set structured_output_enabled false --scope=hosted,dedicated --actor=morgan
```
support_ana: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2800012345 - customers notified. Draft message posted in #support for account teams.
sales_tom: Notifying top-tier customers directly. Sending an incident digest to CSMs now.
Morgan: Also reducing free-tier quotas to blunt accidental high-volume loops.
```
# scale down free-tier agent quotas
/ops quota update --plan=free --resource=agent_exec --multiplier=0.3 --actor=morgan
```
sre_jamie: Metrics look better: end-to-end latency down, agent-exec invocations falling to ~600/min, structured JSON error rate back to baseline.
Morgan: Handing operational ownership to Raj for ongoing monitoring and follow-up. I'll be available but switching to partial coverage in ~45m. :white_check_mark:
Raj: Taking handoff. I'll keep pager and coordinate the post-incident investigation. Immediate next steps: identify offending bot/app, add model-level circuit breakers, and harden rate-limits per API key.
Morgan: Agreed. Postmortem leads: Raj (incident), Ana (customer comms), Jamie (SRE). Sales lead: Tom. I'll file the incident ticket and assign action items after shift. Thanks all. :pray:
